policy: Every reusable operating concern is explicitly installed, delegated, kept project-local, exposed through an adapter, or omitted. Exact source paths and source-specific facts remain in a private run ledger.

areas.concern: One runtime rule shim pointing to one HTML operating map
Agent spawning, supervision, messaging, and teardown
Project skills, roles, commands, recipes, and verification adapters
Engine-neutral specialist role discovery
Canonical work identity and lifecycle
Sprints, runs, packets, gates, returns, and closeout
Structured resume history and active mission ownership
Question-oriented durable documentation discovery
Durable technical breadcrumbs that are not status
Change-shaped file, boundary, and verification routes
Binding choices and supersession
Evidence grade, provenance, and decay
Discovery of earlier attempts and outcomes
Research coverage, gaps, and known dead ends
Joined view of stale proof, dead ends, unresolved runs, and memory
public_surfaces: generated joined onboarding JSON and HTML

areas.concern: One reusable fact per project memory record
Task-linked UI intent, divergence, candidates, review, decision, and proof
Independent verification, landing, and task evidence promotion
Recoverable historical disposition
Narrative project timeline
areas.boundary: Optional authored domain document; do not infer a universal story from mixed records.

areas.concern: Product safety, access, and operator policy
areas.boundary: The project authors its own policy and proof; the package supplies only homes and generic receipt types.

areas.concern: Models, budgets, terminals, telemetry, and persistent workers
Code-layout annotations and semantic context graph
Optional generation, browser, deployment, and tracker integrations
areas.boundary: Adapters declare capability and receipts; they never become required canonical writers.
